name: West Virginia

context: WV 603: Herbaceous wind barriers are narrow strips of herbaceous plants in a field to reduce wind speed and wind erosion on cropland where wind erosion is a concern.
WV 603: Design barriers at least 1.5 feet tall with porosity of 40 to 50 percent in critical wind erosion periods. Spacing must not exceed 10 times barrier height.
cover_rules: WV 340: Aim for at least 90-percent combined canopy and surface residue cover during periods of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
WV 340: Time cover crop establishment with other practices to protect soil during critical erosion periods, using current erosion prediction technology.
residue: WV 329: Maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
WV 329: Limited tillage may close or level harvest ruts; no more than 10 percent of the field.
